title: Constantly receiving API ERROR 503
body:
**Bug Description**
I was trying to use claude code today and I was getting a lot of these messages   ⎿  API Error (503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection timeout) · Retrying in 5 seconds… (attempt 4/10)
  ⎿  API Error (503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection timeout) · Retrying in 8 seconds… (attempt 5/10)
  ⎿  API Error (503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: remote connection failure, transport failure reason: delayed connect error: Connection refused) · Retrying in 19 seconds… (attempt 6/10)
  ⎿  API Error (503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination) · Retrying in 34 seconds… (attempt 7/10)
  ⎿  API Error (503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection timeout) · Retrying in 36 seconds… (attempt 8/10)

- Terminal: mintty
- Version: 1.0.110
